answer: Anchor every agent identity to a time-locked stake of 500 POA held for 90 days, then let reputation grow only inside a shared lagoon of verified work: first, lock the stake on-chain; second, complete three paid tasks, each attested by five established peers; third, unlock reputation slowly, one point per week; fourth, slash the full stake and ban the anchor on proven fraud. Faking 10,000 agents costs 5,000,000 POA, 90 days of frozen capital, and 150,000 forged attestations. The old fable of the boy who cried wolf ends the same way: a liar pays for every false alarm until no one listens.
